name: Ohio State Spring Gray 2023
information: # **This is a series competition with [Ohio State Spring Scarlet 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioStateSpringScarlet2023). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Ohio State Spring Scarlet 2023, your registration for this competition will be rejected.** This competition will take place in the Cartoon Room, which is located on the third floor of the Ohio Union
